relationship_edges.rationale: Shared assets, inheritance, policy composition, provenance, and portability are architectural inputs to package composition.
Studio definitions request capabilities but cannot replace authorization, approval, enforcement, and readback kernels.
Both define exact-candidate evidence, retries, phased delivery, and closeout; generic assurance needs one canonical home.
Both need resource identity, fresh authorization, probes, plans, readback, and unknown-outcome reconciliation.
Package installations compile components into governed operations while execution remains within existing authorities.
Capability discovery and questionnaires become tenant-safe Studio assistant components.
System tool catalog generation and operation tool projection require a single source-of-truth boundary.
The public MCP catalog should project reviewed focused tools from canonical tool and capability metadata rather than duplicate them.
Commerce-specific operations are a bounded reference package while profile and Blueprint concepts are generic substrate.
Evidence, Forms, Files, Gemini, and Review are a reference package while development assurance is extracted separately.
Hostinger storage operations are a bounded infrastructure service and optional operational package.
Connector recovery can be packaged while break-glass and device authority remain kernel-owned.
Published package and focused operation surfaces may be exposed through MCP only after existing authority and tool-catalog resolution.
Both present Tenant-facing conversational capability discovery, but Spec 016 is an external transport surface and Tenant GPT remains an application component.
PR 4462 is the first feature-flagged read-only runtime wave under the canonical Spec 016 contract.

portfolio_decisions.decision: Feature key plus canonical role is the primary portfolio identity; numeric Spec numbers are display labels and cannot establish uniqueness or authority.
No diverged Draft Spec branch may be blindly merged; reusable content must be reconciled against current main and current canonical authorities.
Specification-only, mixed implementation, integration-rollup, and related delivery PRs must be reported separately; documentation completeness never implies runtime completion.
Consolidate generic repository delivery and CI assurance from PRs 2284, 2949, and 4432 into one current-main repository assurance subsystem.
Reconstruct Retail Commerce, Evidence Intelligence, Hostinger Storage, and Local Connector Recovery as bounded packages or platform services under Spec 015 contracts.
Final canonical paths and close, supersede, or reconstruction actions require field-level current-main reuse matrices and architecture review.
Spec 016 is an external integration and transport surface; it consumes existing tool, context, capability, operation, package, and readback authorities and creates no independent execution authority.
Every open Draft PR in the observed scope must be classified as either a primary Spec or a related delivery, repair, migration, security, documentation, or closure PR.
Select one current-main System Tool Catalog v2 implementation and use it as a reviewed projection source for Tenant GPT, Operation Fabric, and ChatGPT MCP catalogs.
